status: 按用户纠正重做；未定稿；正式APP未替换

rules.primary: 海外主推种子，东方智慧为根；陪伴、共修、赋能、觉醒、养成习惯
rules.hierarchy: 种子为主，太极流转相生仅作内在脉络；主次分层
rules.tone: 安静、克制、有韧性、温和；日日滋养的持续成长，不是瞬间顿悟
rules.seed: 待萌发、微微蓄势；芽尖含蓄，不用已发很大芽的种子
community: 个体独立生长，彼此滋养
rules.auxiliary: 重构太极仅作国内厚重路线备选；八卦仅辅助纹样/架构背景；螺旋可作为生成逻辑；莲花慎用
avoid: 完整太极双鱼或黑白强对比主标
仅旋转或换色的重复款
rules.copy: Everyone carries inner wisdom. Nurture it daily, grow together.

selected.construction: 完整横置种子，短流转脉络收在内部
两颗独立种子互相贴合，间隙形成流转
两颗种子从共同基部相连，共修关系进入结构

discarded.reason: 内部脉络有不适当的生物形态联想，不选
偏火焰轮廓，未充分满足安静种子要求，不选

prompts:
Use case: logo-brand. NEW logo design for an international Eastern wisdom APP. Read this strategic brief literally: the brand is a patient ongoing companion for daily self-cultivation and habit, not a showcase of ancient learning, instant enlightenment, spiritual miracles or a medical promise. Primary symbol is a dormant SEED, inner wisdom already present, just poised to emerge. Eastern root is implicit in mutual-generation flowing logic, not an overt philosophy emblem. A very restrained S-like curved embryonic growth vein should live INSIDE the seed, not split its entire outline into two yin-yang fish. No large shoot. Quiet, warm, resilient, inward energy. Two emotional possibilities are individual seeds supporting one another and seeds sharing a common origin. Simplicity equal to a strong app icon: 1 to 3 broad shapes, excellent monochrome legibility, no microscopic detail.
STRICT: no lotus, no full taiji or fish dots, no bagua, no Buddha, no religious paraphernalia, no halos, sun, star, flashes, glowing effects, technology circuits, roots drawn as networks, large leaves or sprouts, flame/water-drop silhouette, coffee-bean stripe running top to bottom, excessive symbolism, gradient, dimensional rendering or textures. This is calm, simple brand design, not botanical illustration.
Presentation: one SINGLE original logo concept only, large centered on plain warm ivory background, crisp vector-like solid muted blue-grey jade ink, no text, no slogan, no name, no explanation, no grid, no mockup. Beneath it show two small exact reproductions of the SAME mark: solid black and ivory on a plain muted jade rounded-square app tile. Preserve identical geometry in all three. Generous clear whitespace. Flat color.
SPECIFIC CONCEPT 01 / INHERENT WISDOM: ONE complete softly asymmetric seed hull, a slightly slanted rounded kernel with a broad stable base and a very short blunt germination shoulder. The outer silhouette remains almost completely CLOSED and unbroken: this must not be two separate leaf halves. Inside it, a SINGLE compact curved negative-space embryo path, gently bending twice like a resting S, starting and ending INSIDE the hull; one end slightly rounder, the other subtly tapering like potential just stirring. Maintain a thick surrounding seed shell. Its meaning is 'the wisdom is already within; patient daily care lets it unfold'. The tiny embryonic curve must feel organic and quiet, not a letter S, not a coffee stripe, not yin-yang, not a logo of fire. No dots. Approximately as wide as tall, with a slight natural lean.

Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE original ultra-simple logo concept for an overseas Eastern wisdom daily-practice and community APP. Strategic meaning: everyone already carries inner wisdom; daily care, habits, companionship and shared practice nurture patient growth. A SEED is the principal symbol. Eastern philosophical flow is implicit, not full taiji. Calm, warm, resilient, inward, not instant enlightenment.
SPECIFIC CONCEPT: "Independent seeds, mutual nourishment". Create TWO compact, plump, softly asymmetric dormant SEED forms, each with a complete rounded blunt outer silhouette. They nest closely side by side, one slightly smaller and slightly higher, like companions supporting each other while remaining distinct. Each is an unadorned broad solid shape, NO inner vein or dot. The gently meandering NEGATIVE SPACE BETWEEN the TWO seeds subtly follows an S-shaped mutual-generation curve. Their paired overall silhouette is compact and grounded, approximately square, not heart shaped. Only two shapes total. Both look like small resting kernels, NOT leaves, NOT flames, NOT people. No pointed sprout. A barely implied opening at their meeting shoulders suggests future growth. The S is felt through their mutual fit, not drawn as a letter or literal yin-yang. Convey quiet company and independent inner potential with exact minimal geometry and negative space.
Single muted jade-grey solid ink on plain ivory. One large central mark and below it two small exact matching applications: solid black mark, ivory mark in jade rounded-square app tile. No text, no borders, no shadows, no gradients, no glossy rendering, no botanical texture. Crisp flat vector-like identity work.
Avoid ALL of: lotus, halos, rays, sun, stars, full yin-yang, bagua, roots illustration, religious symbols, big leaves or shoots, coffee-bean stripes, flame shapes, elongated teardrops, sperm-like shapes, embryo-with-tail pictograms, letter S, heart logo, hugging people pictogram. Broad shapes readable at 32px. Subtle, original and restrained.

Use case: logo-brand. ONE ORIGINAL logo concept for an international app rooted in Eastern wisdom: quiet daily companionship, patient awakening from inner potential, habit and shared cultivation. Main symbol is a SEED just poised to germinate, not a tree, lotus, leaf or fire. Philosophy of yin-yang mutual generation is expressed through subtle curving growth structure, not a taiji diagram.
SPECIFIC CONCEPT "SHARED ORIGIN": ONE broad, rounded, softly asymmetric seed hull with a full grounded bottom and barely indicated blunt growth shoulder. Two broad curved internal negative-space channels rise from the SAME SHORT COMMON ORIGIN inside the lower part of the seed and gently lean toward one another above. They share one small visible solid root bridge at the base: one continuous living form, two quietly emerging potentials, never separate disconnected floating seeds. Make a very economical, warm icon: only the full seed silhouette and two SIMPLE generous curved cutouts, two or three bold areas maximum. The internal curves imply flow and mutual nurture; do NOT draw fine roots, veins, branches, fingers, hands, human figures or leaf tips. An app for growing together with patience, not a plant nursery. Outer width about equal to height, no elongated droplet, no pointed flame peak. No round embryo head with long tail.
Plain ivory background. Flat muted earthy bronze single ink. One large centered symbol with two small exact matching applications below: black mark and ivory mark on a bronze rounded-square app tile. No typography, no numbers, no mockup, no shadows, no gradients, no lights or glow, no paper texture. Crisp, decisive, vector-like silhouette, readable at small sizes. Not ornate. No full yin-yang, no bagua, religion, lotus, sun, stars, halo, coffee stripes, heart shapes or infinity symbols. The shared origin must be visually present in the geometry, not supplied only by explanatory text.

Design a minimalist brand symbol: a dormant SEED viewed on its SIDE, horizontal, gently asymmetric, quietly full of potential. This is for an Eastern wisdom app focused on daily habits and patient shared cultivation. It is NOT a flame, drop, leaf, religious emblem, fertility mark or coffee company.
The SEED OUTER HULL is ONE CLOSED silhouette with a low horizontal profile: width about 1.4 times height, oval with gently flattened underside, a short softly tapered blunt shoulder at the right, rounded left end, no pointed top. It rests calmly instead of shooting upward.
INSIDE the hull, ONE small ivory negative-space vein bends twice in a subtle S-shaped FLOW, occupying only the central 45% of the seed. It has nearly uniform width, TWO equally BLUNT ends, no round bulb/head, no tail, and does NOT touch either outer edge. Think a short quiet path of mutual nourishment held within a real seed. Keep a thick intact shell all around the internal path. No eye dots, line art or anatomical features. Barely a small inward notch at the right shoulder may suggest potential germination, but there must be no visible sprout or leaf.
Meaning comes from holding and nurturing inner potential day after day; the S is an implicit Eastern mutual-generation logic, not a full yin-yang diagram. A living seed with inner wisdom, not a stylised letter S. Calm and patient, restrained, 2D and extremely simple.
One original logo concept on plain ivory, large central mark in flat muted jade grey, below it an EXACT same small black mark and an EXACT same ivory-on-jade rounded-square icon. No words. No textures, shading, gradients, shadows, glow, sun, stars, sparkles, lotus, taiji, mandala, ornamental roots. Use crisp broad forms and generous negative space suitable for a tiny app icon. This is a SINGLE symbol, not a sheet of variants. Professional identity design, no mockup realism.

Original minimalist logo for an overseas Eastern wisdom app. Daily companionship, shared cultivation, patient habits, inward awakening. Symbol is dormant SEEDS with latent potential. This concept must visibly express COMMON ORIGIN, not merely two nearby shapes.
Draw TWO small horizontal resting SEED KERNELS, slightly different sizes, nested diagonally with a little space between their full rounded bodies. Both kernels are blunt and quietly enclosed, no stems, no leaves or sprouting plants. Their LOWER EDGES merge through ONE SHORT, broad, softly curving shared BASE/ROOT BRIDGE. This bridge is genuinely connected to both kernels, so the entire mark is ONE continuous solid shape. The central ivory space between the resting kernels gently bends like a soft S, hinting at Eastern mutual generation. The bridge should feel like common origin and quiet continuity, not hands, bowl, smile or an infinity sign. Total geometry is extremely economical: two seed volumes and one connecting curve integrated into one silhouette, one negative-space passage. Strong grounded near-square composition, no sharp upward tip. This is two dormant seeds sharing one root source, not a plant illustration.
No interior dots or vein lines; the S-like flow occurs only between the seed bodies and through the common bridge. Make it warm and calm, quietly resilient; no drama or spiritual instant-enlightenment effects.
One SINGLE logo concept in flat low-saturation earthy bronze ink on pure warm ivory background. Large mark centered, underneath two smaller EXACT matching representations: black mark, and ivory mark in a bronze rounded-square app tile. No text, no slogans, no labels, no gradients, shadows, texture or 3D.
No lotus, religious motifs, literal yin-yang double fish, dots, bagua, mandala, sun, glow, stars, leaf-shaped pointed flame, big sprouts, realistic roots or root networks, coffee-bean stripes, hearts, human figures, fertility pictograms. Broad clear silhouettes and substantial negative space for small-size app-icon recognition. Professional flat brand design.
